title: Open-Meteo geocoding — Auburn, California, United States
claims: Open-Meteo geocoding returns Auburn, Placer County, California at latitude 38.89657, longitude -121.07689, elevation 374 m.
The result is a town centroid, not the China Wall start line or the downtown finish.
